# libsais 2.10.4

Suffix array construction by induced sorting, from
https://github.com/IlyaGrebnov/libsais (`include/libsais.h`, `src/libsais.c`,
`LICENSE`), unmodified. Apache License 2.0; copyright Ilya Grebnov. Used by
`native/src/cyphalm/infinigram.cpp` to build the ∞-gram index (single-threaded,
built without OpenMP).
